description: From a pullout above the gorge, oak and plane slopes drop to the Nestos, which bends between the walls. A narrow railway trace follows one bank and enters a short tunnel. Cloud cover is about 72%, about 9.0°C. The sun is still below the horizon. There are no lights in the gorge. This is not the 891-metre Thea viewpoint.
